correctness.rationale: Quadratic Gauss sum gives |X_m|=2^(2m-1)+2^(m-1) and conditional Gram DGD=(2^m I+PW)/(2^m+1), with P the pair swap and W the Hamming-ball Krawtchouk (-1)^|A∩B| matrix. The symmetric-group rank0/1/2 decomposition yields a 3x3 trivial-sector cubic p_n, a 2x2 standard-sector quadratic with s±, and +4 pair-harmonic sector. P signs give the displayed multiplicities; the m=2 nullity-one and m>=3 injectivity also follow by testing Boolean monomials on Q(x)=0. Sylvester criterion and evaluation p_n(-s_-) establish sharp extremes. Independently formed direct full Walsh Gram matrices from all X_m, obtaining agreement of all eigenvalues for m=2,3,4 at <=1.56e-15 and expected boundary nullity. This does not extrapolate finite checks to general m.
